resolved_findings: The complete-workload cost gate now requires six policies, 1080 rollout outcomes and 124704 diagnostic forward calls. Stale five-policy cost estimates are rejected.
reviewed_contracts: The pinned v2 lifecycle is loaded in a private module and its run_wave, child registration, process identity checks, outcome preservation, bounded cleanup, wait4 reaping and observation routines remain unchanged. Only the declared schedule, command, job verifier and pairing callbacks are replaced.
Host A launches base0/mix0/base1/mix1 and host B launches base2/mix2. Each is a direct static host wave, with no old sequential-wave gating and no automatic training/resume/retry.

Every invocation requires a root timing release with exact source/input/interpreter hashes, a distinct graph-support numerical admission, physical GPU inventory and fresh process-identity check. The source, data and release snapshots are retained and rechecked.

Every job requires a fresh single attempt, the exact graph-support schema and faithful recipe, empty initial checkpoint pointer, committed incomplete 512-update endpoint, matched scalar stdout/history/status and full graph ledger. Failures, temp artifacts, stale locks and lineage mismatches are rejected.
Paired base/mix arms must have exactly equal saved frame, noise, LR, native graph and graph-RNG seed evidence for every update. Per-example particle counts are checked against the manifest.

The local expected-LR recomputation allowance is bounded to one float64 ULP, records each discrepancy and does not edit saved rows or trainer arithmetic. Exact saved LR equality between paired arms is retained. The cited prior ARM/Mac scalar audit failure remains preserved.

Combination requires two complete worker statuses with summary hashes, revalidates every copied input, wave and job artifact, enforces one cohort across distinct hosts and eight distinct physical GPU inventory UUIDs, and requires overlapping conservative steady intervals after the explicit clock-error bounds.

The six-job forecast uses max measured q6 and r6. Complete cost admission remains null until a separately justified full rollout, diagnostic and terminal graph-ledger reserve is supplied; the additional 3600-second verification allowance is retained.
limits: No process, real checkpoint, source trajectory, full model, CUDA device or remote host was exercised by this review.
Initial checkpoint tensor/RNG pairing and scientific final checkpoint admission still require root audits. Capacity checkpoints remain infrastructure-only.
The conservative cross-host interval establishes nominal concurrent active work from sampled process/GPU evidence; it is not a claim that every GPU was saturated at every instant.
The root cost writer remains responsible for an evidence-based conservative terminal-ledger and complete-evaluation estimate. This source review does not establish that the deadline fits.
